# Emitac Boulevard Plaza

> Emitac occupies office space at Boulevard Plaza, a twin-tower commercial complex on Mohammed Bin Rashid Boulevard in Downtown Dubai, immediately beside the Burj Khalifa. Emitac is one of the UAE's long-established information technology companies, supplying hardware, systems and IT services to business and government customers. The two towers rise 37 and 30 storeys above ground, were completed in 2010 and are recognisable for the arched crowns that top each building.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Downtown Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

This project delivered office premises for Emitac at Boulevard Plaza, Emaar's twin-tower commercial development in Downtown Dubai with views towards Burj Khalifa. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the office, providing the building services needed to support a modern, comfortable working environment for the company's teams within this established Downtown Dubai commercial address.
